choicesFromQuestion.description: Name of a select question whose choices are carried forward.

choicesByUrl.description: URL to load choices from; may interpolate {question} placeholders.

choicesPath.description: Dotted path to the array inside the response.

choicesLazyLoadEnabled.description: The list arrives a page at a time from the host loader.

choicesLazyLoadPageSize.description: How many choices one page asks for.

name.description: Unique element identifier. For a question, also its answer key.

title.description: Display title; falls back to name.

visibleIf.description: Expression; the element is shown only while it evaluates truthy.

enableIf.description: Expression; the element is editable only while it evaluates truthy.

startWithNewLine.description: Break onto a fresh row rather than flowing into the columns beside it.

width.description: CSS length. Empty fills its column.

titleLocation.description: default, top, left or hidden. Hidden is visual only; it is still announced.

valueName.description: Answer key, when it should differ from the name. Shared keys share an answer.

readOnly.description: The answer is shown but cannot be changed by the respondent.

requiredIf.description: Expression; when present it overrides isRequired.

requiredErrorText.description: Replaces the built-in message shown when a required answer is missing.

defaultValueExpression.description: Expression supplying a value while the question is unanswered.

setValueIf.description: Expression; while truthy, setValueExpression drives the answer.

resetValueIf.description: Expression; while truthy the answer is cleared. Wins over the others.

correctAnswer.description: The answer that scores. A question without one is not part of the quiz. Never shown.

inputType.description: text, number, email, date, datetime-local, time, tel, url, color, range or password.

min.description: Lower bound. A number for numeric types, an ISO string for date ones.

max.description: Upper bound, read the same way as min.

text.description: Replaces the built-in message when this check fails.

allowDigits.description: Set false to reject an answer containing any digit.
